dispositions.evidence: Repaired both prior actual counterexamples. Exact QA5 script exit101 in5.515865s with no Python survivors before fallback. Exact QA6 stopped-inventory PID74125 at5.103323s, root already exited by5.501330s, explicit timed-out inventory error instead of unbounded wait. Extended independent audit: Python PIDs75116/75115,PGID75115,SID75109 and stopped inventoryPID75185; final PID,PGID,SID,inventory and outer-session survivor arrays all empty BEFORE fallback. Native inventory timeout/unwind proof2/2 passes with actual ESRCH reap at50.503833ms and1.572416ms. Source now owns ps lifetime/output and cleanup absolute attempt.

Changed shared-helper ownership flag independently assessed, not claimed byte-identical. FixtureChild::spawn sets cleanup_on_drop=true; only SessionFixture transfers it tofalse. Store test paths retain defaulttrue. Independent existing current store binary five focused tests passed: all3 real post-call stalled joins killed/reaped5.005616s/5.003439s/5.004623s; original500ms failure observations reached; parent unwind cleanup2.827459ms. All three normal strict store fixtures passed. Actual store schedule.rs unchanged.

Relevant accepted production files byte-identical to dc468b9c, which preserved95def5f3 service closure. Manifest/lock/runtime unchanged. No service implementation or producer correction in this helper-only fix; carry owning service closure, not a fresh whole-runtime certification.

review_evidence: Verified assigned exact branch/clean HEAD before analysis and final artifact creation. Named Cursor/Sonnet configuration unavailable; inherited available model honestly used. No Cargo commands, product/source edits, or agents by this reviewer; independently exercised existing compiled binaries and bounded source-free drivers.

Inventory::spawn stores stdout/stderr in owned temporary file and uses explicit Child ownership, no pipe reader threads. finish polls try_wait before reading file; per-invocation deadline is min(original absolute phase deadline,now+50ms). Timeout sends SIGKILL and wait/reap; Drop reaps on error/assertion unwind. A SIGSTOPped ps cannot prevent deadline observation. Native tests prove actual disappearance, not merely kill request.

SessionFixture cleanup_started records one cleanup attempt. The 250 ms quiesce deadline and one-second final deadline share that start. Inventory time counts inside each phase. SessionFixture Drop does not retry after cleanup begins; underlying FixtureChild cleanup_on_drop=false prevents a second registry cleanup budget. Error-retaining drain retries use only the remaining budget and preserve the error as test failure.

Kernel session ownership via setsid before runtime, stores and PythonJob construction remains intact. Initial live-runtime drain allows real child reaping. Quiescence stops root and members and requires stable quiet membership. Root kill/wait and final SID drain cover in-flight and reparented launches. Python groups inherit SID before registration; child PID receipts are diagnostic only.

All previously flagged store joins, management.await, run.await, second.await, Python worker join and runtime teardown remain inside owned fixture lifetimes. Original 30 ms, 500 ms, 100 ms, 300 ms, T=250 ms and two-second assertions are unchanged. cron_hurry.rs and PyStub bodies are byte-identical to QA6; actual production PythonJob is unchanged.

Linux reads raw /proc/<pid>/stat identity. The final right parenthesis handles comm names containing spaces or parentheses; state and ppid precede pgrp and session. Nonpositive groups and SIDs are excluded before typed Pid construction. NotFound, ESRCH and inaccessible processes are tolerated. Signal targets revalidate SID and group. Other Unix targets use getsid/getpgid; crate-level cfg(unix) excludes this helper on Windows.

Following cass rule b-mr7cp6x0-ipdnhs: parent-linux-job.json confirms exact-head hosted Ubuntu job126359464313 SUCCESS including Test and both Clippy steps. Parent CI snapshot separately shows Python checks succeeding on Linux, macOS and Windows; core macOS/Windows remain in progress and the boundary job failed. Local Darwin evidence does not establish all-platform CI acceptance.

Developer 11 lifecycle/inventory tests, five store tests and source-free audits corroborate the independent probes. Prior QA6 Linux abort evidence was read. Raw identity validation avoids the zero-SID typed assertion; exact-source hosted Linux Test passed. RustQA7 owns compiler provenance, lint and Cargo suite validation.
No new canonical IDs or waivers. REQ-QA-004, ARCH-001, RBQA-F001 and QA2-001 retain open states outside this assigned finding. No whole-C1, CI, anchor or merge PASS claimed.
verification_limitations: Independent local execution used existing Darwin binaries. No Cargo rebuild or Linux/Windows execution by this role. Lifecycle binary SHA256 0d523fc2a06a7f97bc64cfc2a8745ce94d97008a039413cb8f03af6ded959ffb matches developer final binary. Store SHA256 590b2d194d88355607c8341b17412ae0293d5994f8ffe35824be61827f803e6e; binary mtime18:56:11 follows helper mtime18:54:24. RustQA7 retains compiler provenance responsibility.

Kernel SIGKILL failure and uninterruptible kernel waits were not injected. The distinct owned ps user-space stall was explicitly exercised and terminated finitely. File I/O and kernel primitives rely on normal operating-system progress; universal syscall bounds are not claimed.

Inventory failures cannot produce a successful receipt. Initial inventory runs before fixture spawn; later errors remain failures while cleanup uses its original budget. Native inventory timeout/unwind and supervisor inventory-error paths were verified. Every possible host resource failure was not exhaustively injected.
